text:
Wide cinematic digital painting of a futuristic desert city at twilight. Center: a cluster of three tall tapering glass skyscrapers. The tallest, in the middle, is crowned by a glowing cyan neon halo ring. To its left is a teal-lit spire with a vertical cyan neon sign reading "OASIS". To its right is a violet/magenta-glowing spire. At their bases sit tiered, saucer-like domed buildings and a dense low skyline of small lit towers. Four thin teal searchlight beams fan up into the sky from the city.

The sky is a gradient from deep navy with scattered stars at the top to purple, then warm orange glow at the horizon on the right. In the upper left hangs a huge pale crescent moon.

Foreground left: a person in a long flowing red-maroon cloak stands on a sand ridge, seen from behind, gazing toward the city. Beside them on the left stands a shaggy fluffy alpaca. Wind blows wisps of sand off the rippled orange dunes.

Right side: a sleek white monorail train glides along an elevated curving track lined with warm golden lights, winding from the city toward the foreground lower right. Behind it is a turquoise oasis pool. On the far right stands a tall saguaro cactus outlined in pink neon, with a smaller cactus in the distance.

Warm golden sand contrasts with cool teal and violet neon. Retro-futurist sci-fi concept art with soft atmospheric haze and a 16:9 composition.
